ShadowPit

Form your analysis around interesting and obvious levels, a single chart mark up could involve the following 7 step process: Step 1: Draw a horizontal line along support or resistance. Step 2: Label the engulfs (ENG) of this line when they occur. Step 3: Label the decision points (DP) of those ENG. Step 4: Label the FTRs that form AT or AFTER the DP has formed. Step 5: Observe when price is capped by a DP or FTR...this will give you an idea who is in control, buyers or sellers, whilst keeping you out of bad trades. Step 6: Observe when price engulfs a DP or FTR you have labelled. Step 7: Label the NEW DP. Rinse and repeat.

Now imagine the power when you combine this with multi-timeframe analysis and when you wait for the price action to confirm your bias.

You have to take some losers in this game or suffer some draw down. Here's a non-cherry picked trade where I ended up waiting out on the draw down, where I could have just taken the 5 pip loss and made it back later, but that is my mistake. Same logic and planning. Could have scalped it both ways. In this case I had HTF targets in mind. The message: plan your trades!!!!

Left hand side. Setting the scene

Right hand side. Failure, but further opportunity.
